sources.title: Anos 90 — Sobre a Revista
sources.note: Official journal focus-and-scope page read directly. It publishes advanced recent research in history and related fields that contributes to historical knowledge. No Brazilian or Latin American study region is specified by the remit.

sources.title: Esboços: histórias em contextos globais — Sobre a Revista
sources.note: Official journal focus-and-scope page read directly. Its stated purpose is debate in global history through transcultural, connected, transnational, comparative, maritime and world-system approaches. Its Brazilian university home is not treated as study geography.

sources.title: Revista Estudos Históricos — Sobre a Revista
sources.note: Official journal focus-and-scope page read directly. It publishes interdisciplinary work with a historical perspective by researchers in history, social sciences and related fields. The current page does not limit study geography to Brazil.

sources.title: Fronteras de la Historia — Sobre la revista
sources.note: Official ICANH journal page read directly. It specializes in Latin American colonial history from the late fifteenth to early nineteenth centuries, while accepting adjacent pre-contact and republican-transition work when tied to colonial phenomena.

sources.title: HiSTOReLo: Revista de Historia Regional y Local — DOAJ journal record
sources.note: DOAJ API record read directly after the Universidad Nacional journal page returned HTTP 403. The record, last fully reviewed by DOAJ on 2025-04-03, supplies the keywords local history, regional history and Colombian history and the LCC subject Latin America/Spanish America.

sources.title: Historia Crítica — Acerca de la revista
sources.note: Official journal page read directly. It publishes historical and social-science/humanities research on past and present social, political, economic and cultural settings, including historiographical or theoretical assessments. Colombia is the funding university's location, not a declared limit on study geography.

sources.title: Historia Mexicana — SciELO México serial page
sources.note: SciELO México serial page read directly after the journal's own site returned HTTP 403. Its mission opens the journal to historians and specialists in Mexico, promotes historiographical debate and comparative history, especially with the Hispanic world. Mexico is therefore a stated study subject, not inferred from publication location.

sources.title: Secuencia. Revista de Historia y Ciencias Sociales — Sobre la revista
sources.note: Official journal focus-and-scope page read directly. It publishes research on the historical, cultural, social and political development of Mexico and Ibero-America from the colonial period through the twenty-first century, across history and related social sciences.

sources.title: Revista Tempo e Argumento — Sobre a Revista
sources.note: Official journal mission page read directly. Its central program area is history of the present; it also explicitly fosters theoretical and methodological debate concerning history. No Brazilian study-region restriction is stated.

sources.title: Tzintzun. Revista de Estudios Históricos — Sobre la revista
sources.note: Official journal focus-and-scope page read directly. It is dedicated broadly to disseminating historical knowledge, with multidisciplinary contributions in social sciences and humanities. The Michoacán institutional affiliation does not establish a Mexican geographic remit.

sources.title: Varia Historia — SciELO journal page
sources.note: SciELO journal page read directly. The mission is to publish original and innovative history articles for an international academic community. Its UFMG publication identity does not establish a Brazilian study-region restriction.

sources.title: Revista Brasileira de História — SciELO journal page
sources.note: SciELO journal page read directly. Its mission covers contemporary historiographical production and the practices of historical research, writing and teaching. 'Brasileira' identifies the publishing association; the mission does not restrict studied geography to Brazil.
